scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter frontend-v2 typecheck && pnpm --filter author-cms typecheck
scripts.lint: eslint scripts && pnpm --filter frontend-v2 lint && pnpm --filter author-cms lint
scripts.format: prettier --write --ignore-unknown .prettierrc.json README.md package.json eslint.config.js deploy frontend-v2 scripts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check --ignore-unknown .prettierrc.json README.md package.json eslint.config.js deploy frontend-v2 scripts
scripts.verify: pnpm --filter frontend-v2 verify && pnpm --filter author-cms verify && sh tests/ops/run.sh
scripts.local:up: docker compose --env-file .env --env-file .env.local -f deploy/compose.yaml -f deploy/compose.local.yaml up -d postgres cms site
scripts.local:logs: docker compose --env-file .env --env-file .env.local -f deploy/compose.yaml -f deploy/compose.local.yaml logs --tail=100 cms site
